resource_type.description: The resources to watch (their type), e.g. supplier — each with a URL.

unavailable_text.description: What their page says when an item is gone (case-insensitive).

notify_integration.description: Slug of a connected integration that can send notifications — Slack, Apprise… (Settings → Integrations).

timezone.description: The time zone the schedule runs in (IANA name).
